rationale: The exact decision's provisional NO recommendation is supported within the supplied source perimeter. EO 13998 §§1–6, 86 FR 7205–7208 (PDF pp.1–4). Sections 2–5 contain transport masking, exceptions/safeguards and regular progress updates, additional domestic measures, state support, international air/land/sea travel, diplomatic consultation and vaccine-certificate assessment. Neither early plan deadlines nor cessation of one masking measure would establish whole-command coverage. EO14122 §2, 89 FR 27355, PDF p.1, expressly revokes EO13998 as a whole, covering the complete §§2–5 domestic/international-travel and coordination commands. Section 3 transfers coordinator responsibilities separately and does not save a continuing EO13998 command regime. The selected native basis ACT:EO:13998>EO:14122 now corresponds to that source. EO13998 §6 and EO14122 §4 preserve independent statutory agency authority and OMB functions, not an independent target-command regime. Exceptions and safeguards under EO13998 §2 delimit its former operation; surviving agency rules and accrued effects require separate lifecycle analysis. Full EO14148 §2 does not list EO14122, and its full text supplies no affirmative re-enactment of EO13998. Rescissions concerning other COVID instruments do not restore this order.

remaining_source_action: Obtain domestic transport masking actions, international travel plans/rules, diplomatic and vaccination-certificate records, coordinator updates and pertinent judicial/agency decisions; test each command's actual completion or earlier cessation before the later whole-order revocation.
source_reuse: Complete prior independent source readings reused only after maintained byte/span verification and source hash equality checks. Three newly supplied exact versions examined after the earlier seal; nine other accepted exact decision hashes remain unchanged.
source_evidence_limits: Underlying API/index/agency/court search records, evidence dossier contents and history-packet contents were not opened. Their supplied fingerprints are pinned, not independently reconstructed here. Status acceptance uses positive primary-source revocation and the complete supplied contrary text; it is not an exhaustive absence-of-restoration claim through cutoff.
source_page_method: All complete held primary-source texts were independently read before original decision fields; fresh PDF text extraction matched all held pages after whitespace normalization. Visual inspection covered EO10582 raw pp.1,3; EO14029 p.1; EO14003 p.1; EO14005 p.4; EO14122 p.1; EO14148 pp.2,5. Other modern pages were read as full extracted page text; full visual inspection of every page is not claimed.
